verdict.rationale: Discord documents building automated apps, commands, and integrations, so automation versioning is a fair question for this kind of platform. However, nothing in the evidence shows Discord itself letting users version, review, or roll back those automations. Any versioning would have to come from the developer's own tooling, which is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
